title: Read-only evaluator refused a pure read pipeline (grep -o … | sort | uniq -c); decide whether pipelines of read-only commands are recognized
outcome: Read-only evaluator refused a pure read pipeline (grep -o … | sort | uniq -c); decide whether pipelines of read-only commands are recognized
acceptance: The governing rule is identified with file:line: which component refused `grep -o '"bin": "[^"]*"' FILE | sort | uniq -c` in a readOnly evaluator, and whether refusing pipelines of read-only commands is intended.

Either (a) a pipeline whose every stage is a recognized read-only command with no redirection or write is admitted, with a regression covering it and a regression proving a pipeline with a writing stage or redirection is still refused; or (b) the restriction is documented as intended where evaluator briefs/read-only policy are described, and the refusal text names the rule and the allowed alternative (the Grep tool).
The refusal text is retained in the evaluator result so a reporter can quote it.
